name: 7-Eleven Combined Distribution Center Commerce City CO (E.A. Sween Denver)

fieldNotes.facility: E.A. Sween 'Denver VAS' fresh-food / value-added-services distribution operation occupying a unit (5700 Unit D) of the multi-tenant Park Industrial Center flex park (5690 / 5700 / 5710 E 56th Ave), just north of I-270. Audited building is the center N-S flex building; this is the 7-Eleven fresh/commissary supply node, not a tractor-trailer regional DC.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open driveway off E 56th Ave directly into the shared truck court; Street View from 2020-2024 shows no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, booth, or checkpoint at any complex entry. Open-access flex park.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth anywhere at the entries.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Center 5700 building has docks on both west and east faces (mix of dock-height and grade-level overhead doors). Counted ~12-18 across both faces from overhead + Street View; banded 10-25. Tenant's own unit uses only a subset.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A handful of trailers (incl. at least one reefer) parked without tractor in the shared courts; well under 10 dedicated drop stalls.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot; shallow shared aprons flanking the building, not a standalone drop yard.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two open vehicular accesses serve the building's courts (north drive off 56th Ave and the through-drive on the east), neither controlled.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Denver-metro industrial fabric, fully built-up corridor along I-270 / 56th Ave.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is unrelated.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Best driver's-eye is the 56th Ave arrival pano (3uPQg8iaeDd39YKn8rWGuA, 2020-11) looking south into the open complex entrance.
